data.one_liner: Shadcn/ui design system ported to Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of fully customizable, shadcn-styled UI components for Flutter applications across multiple platforms. Includes accordion, buttons, dialogs, forms, popovers, tabs, and more.
use_when: You want to build a Flutter app with the modern shadcn/ui aesthetic.
You need highly customizable and modular UI components.
avoid_when: Your project strictly relies on standard Material Design or Cupertino style guidelines without customization.
You are using very old Flutter versions below 3.47.
strengths: Extensive library of port components from shadcn/ui.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Requires migration away from legacy flutter material/cupertino imports to standalone packages like material_ui in version 0.60.0+.
Some niche components of shadcn/ui might still be in progress.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package and updating dependencies according to recent breaking changes involving standalone material_ui and cupertino_ui packages for Flutter 3.47+.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer traditional Material Design components over the shadcn style.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want native-feeling Apple iOS design components.
